description: This file defines the PresenceReporter class responsible for managing and broadcasting system presence information, including periodic status updates and immediate notifications, tailored for a macOS application.

classes.name: PresenceReporter
classes.description: A singleton class that manages system presence reporting, including periodic updates and immediate notifications, primarily for macOS in the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the periodic presence reporting task that sends updates every few minutes.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing presence reporting task.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Asynchronously composes and sends a system presence event with contextual information.

methods.name: sendImmediate
methods.description: Immediately triggers a presence update with a specified reason.

methods.name: composePresenceSummary
methods.description: Constructs a summary string for the presence report based on current system state.

methods.name: appVersionString
methods.description: Retrieves the app version string, including build if available.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Constructs a string representing the operating system version.
